newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil scores trade surplus on first day of August.
newsitem.headline: Brazil scores trade surplus on first day of August.

text.p: Brazil scored a $109 million trade surplus on the first day of August, with exports of $258 million and imports of $149 million, said a government official with access to the figures.
The official asked not to be identified.
The Ministry of Industry and Commerce is due to announce July's trade balance Tuesday morning.
Government sources say last month saw a wider-than-expected trade gap of about $811 million.
